scripts.e2e:client: cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:6312/api npm --prefix client-app run start:e2e
scripts.e2e:stack: concurrently -k -s first -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run e2e:server" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:6312/api/health && npm run e2e:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client-app install
